name: property-row
title: Property row
summary: A setting in an inspector: a small muted label beside its control, on one line.
use: For dense settings panels where many values are read and changed together.

options.name: label width
options.description: Shared by a group so controls line up.

rules: Controls inside hide their own label; the row's label names them for assistive technology.
Align every row of a group on one label width.
accessibility: The control is labelled by the row's label.
